The '''128th Flight''' was a [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] comprised of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] [[Color/Legends|colored]] light-blue and light-gray that<ref name="mini128" />&mdash;as with the Vulture [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of [[72nd Flight]]<ref name="mini72">{{PocketModel|set=Base Set|cardname=72nd Flight Droid Fighter|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/ship14c.jpg}}</ref>&mdash;had more accurate targeting systems, but less defensive capabilities, than the droid [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] of [[28th Flight]]<ref name="mini28">{{PocketModel|set=Base Set|cardname=28th Flight Droid Fighter|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/ship14d.jpg}}</ref> and [[31st Flight]].<ref name="mini31">{{PocketModel|set=Base Set|cardname=31st Flight Droid Fighter|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/ship13c.jpg}}</ref> The 128th Flight of droid starfighters fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as part of the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]].<ref name="mini128" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 128th Flight was represented with a miniature in the [[Star Wars PocketModel TCG: Base Set|initial release]] of the [[Star Wars PocketModel TCG|''Star Wars PocketModel'' trading card game]]<ref name="mini128" /> in [[2007]].<ref name="date">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/misc/news20070426.html|text=Closer Look: ''Star Wars'' PocketModel Trading Card Game}}</ref>
